title: पूर्वाञ्चलको इतिहास लेखन : समस्या र समाधान Purbanchalko Itihas Lekhan: Samasya ra Samadhan
authors: कार्की Karki, गोविन्द मान Govinda man सिंह Singh
nepali: नेपालको इतिहास लेखनमा सर्वप्रथम अङ्ग्रेजहरूले कलम चलाएको पाइन्छ ।तर विगतका पछिल्ला वर्षहरूमा नेपालका विद्वान तथा शोधकर्ताहरूले राजधनीकाठमाडौँबाट वाहिर गएर मेचीदेखि महाकालीसम्म सबैतिरका राजनैतिक, सामाजिक,आर्थिक, प्रशासनिक, सास्कृतिक, धार्मिक आदि विषयसँग सम्वन्धित विषयहरूमा खोज रअनुसन्धान गर्ने परम्पराको थालनी भएको छ । यसै सन्दर्भमा नेपालको पश्चिम र पूर्वीक्षेत्रको इतिहास क्रमशः उजागर हुँदैछ । तर तुलानात्मक रूपमा पश्चिमाञ्चल क्षेत्रकोअनुपातमा पूर्वाञ्चल क्षेत्रको इतिहास लेखनमा ठोस उपलब्धि हात लाग्नसकेको छैन ।वास्तवमा क्षेत्रीय इतिहास नआइकन राष्ट्रिय इतिहास पूर्ण हुँदैन । यसै सन्दर्भमाविभिन्न विषयमा विभिन्न विद्वानहरूले पूर्वाञ्चल क्षेत्रलाई केन्द्रविन्दु वनाएर इतिहासलेखिरहेका छन् । तथापि शोधकार्य हुनुपर्ने विषयहरू धेरै छन्, जसमा आजसम्मविद्वानहरूको ध्यान गएको छैन । यस लेखमा पूर्वाञ्चलमा हालसम्म भएका शोधकार्य,हुनुपर्ने काम, शोधकार्यमा रहेका समस्या र तिनीहरूको निराकरण जस्ता विषयमाकेन्द्रित रहेर चर्चा गरिएको छ ।
american_english: In the writing of Nepal's history, it is found that the English first took up the pen. But in recent years, Nepal's scholars and researchers have begun the tradition of going outside the capital Kathmandu and carrying out exploration and research on subjects connected with political, social, economic, administrative, cultural, religious and other topics across the entire area from Mechi to Mahakali. In the same context, the history of Nepal's western and eastern regions is coming to light in turn. But proportionally, compared with the Western Region, no solid achievement has been attained in the writing of the history of the Eastern Region. In reality, national history cannot be complete without regional history. In the same context, various scholars are writing history centring on the Eastern Region in various fields. Nevertheless, there are many subjects that should be researched, to which scholars' attention has not yet turned. This article focuses on subjects such as the research work done so far in the Eastern Region, the work that remains to be done, the problems existing in research and their solutions, and discusses them.
british_english: In the historiography of Nepal, it is apparent that the English were the first to take up the pen. However, in latter years Nepal's scholars and researchers have begun a tradition of leaving the capital, Kathmandu, and conducting exploration and research into subjects connected with the political, social, economic, administrative, cultural, religious and other affairs of the whole tract from Mechi to Mahakali. In the same connection, the history of Nepal's western and eastern regions is progressively coming to light. Yet, in comparative terms, measured against the Western Region, no solid achievement has been secured in the historiography of the Eastern Region. In truth, national history cannot be complete without regional history. In the same connection, various scholars are writing history with the Eastern Region as their focal point on a range of subjects. Even so, there are numerous subjects that deserve research and to which scholars' attention has not yet been directed. This article concentrates on matters such as the research undertaken so far in the Eastern Region, the work that ought to be done, the problems besetting research and their resolution, and offers a discussion of them.
australian_english: Nepal's history was first written up by the British. But in recent years Nepal's scholars and researchers have started getting out beyond the capital, Kathmandu, and doing exploration and research on subjects tied to the political, social, economic, administrative, cultural, religious and other aspects of the whole area from Mechi to Mahakali. Along those lines, the history of Nepal's west and east is coming to light in turn. But by way of comparison, set against the Western Region, no solid gain has come out of writing the history of the Eastern Region. In fact, national history cannot be complete without regional history. In the same vein, different scholars are writing history with the Eastern Region as the focus across various fields. Even so, there are plenty of subjects that should be researched and have not caught scholars' attention yet. This article focuses on things like the research done in the Eastern Region so far, the work that still needs doing, the problems hanging around in research and their solutions, and talks them through.
informal_english: When it comes to writing Nepal's history, it turns out the English were the ones who picked up the pen first. But in recent years Nepal's academics and researchers have got into the habit of heading out from the capital, Kathmandu, and digging into subjects tied up with politics, society, the economy, administration, culture, religion and the like right across the land from Mechi to Mahakali. On that score, the history of Nepal's west and east is coming into the light one after the other. But relatively speaking, measured against the Western Region, nothing solid has come off in the writing of the Eastern Region's history. The thing is, you cannot have a complete national history without the regional histories. On that score too, all sorts of academics are writing history with the Eastern Region front and centre across a bunch of subjects. Still, there are heaps of subjects that should be researched where academics have not taken any notice yet. This piece keeps its eye on things like the research done in the Eastern Region up to now, the work that still needs doing, the problems sitting in research and how to sort them out.
